folds.title: Finding commands
points: Type `/` inside a session to see the commands available.

folds.title: Fresh starts
points: `/clear` starts a new conversation with empty context.
`/resume` brings back an earlier conversation if you need it.

folds.title: Saving space
points: `/compact` frees up space by summarising the conversation so far.
You can tell it what to keep.

folds.title: Set-up and planning
points: `/init` creates a starter **CLAUDE.md** for your project.

folds.title: Undo
points: `/rewind` rolls the code, the conversation, or both back to an earlier point.
Press `Esc` twice for the same menu.
It works alongside git, not instead of it.

folds.title: A day of commands
points: **Long session:** `/compact`, and say what to keep.
folds.note: A few commands cover most days.

more.note: Each command answers one everyday need.
Set up once, then plan before big changes.

folds.prompt: Which command fits? Tap the basket.
